Text: The loyalty service shall exchange purchase events and voucher validation calls with the POS as defined in the TillPoint POS loyalty interface spec v2.1.
Rationale: The POS vendor does not change the interface before TillPoint v2.2 (SH-08).

Text: The loyalty service shall stay outside the PCI DSS cardholder data environment.
Rationale: Security architecture keeps the loyalty service out of PCI DSS scope because it never needs card numbers (SH-05).

Text: The loyalty service shall retain each points transaction record for 7 years.
Rationale: Finance needs transaction records for audit under the retention policy DRP-2024.

Text: The loyalty service shall store member personal data only in data centers located in Singapore.
Rationale: The data protection officer requires member personal data to stay in Singapore under DRP-2024.

Text: The loyalty service shall run on the shared Kubernetes platform.
Rationale: Platform team standard for every new service; no exceptions in 2026 (SH-08).

Text: The loyalty service shall take over earning and redemption from the legacy loyalty module before 2027-03-31.
Rationale: The legacy module's vendor contract ends on 2027-03-31 and is not extended (SH-03).
